Karnataka Minister Resigns Amid Valmiki Scam Allegations

Karnataka Minister B. Nagendra resigned from his cabinet position on June 14, 2024, following allegations related to the Valmiki Corporation scam. Nagendra, who had been re-inducted into the cabinet 25 days prior, reportedly broke down on camera while announcing his resignation. The Valmiki Corporation scam involves alleged irregularities in the distribution of funds meant for the upliftment of the Valmiki community. The opposition has linked the resignation to these allegations, while Nagendra stated he was resigning of his own volition.
